papers.title: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
papers.desc: Hybrid reasoning models such as the Qwen3 series switch between a THINK mode and a NO-THINK mode through a few chat-template tokens.

papers.title: LabInstruct: Benchmarking Situated Instructional Video Generation for Lab Procedures
papers.desc: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) aim to automate the full experimental loop, from scientific decision-making to physical execution.

papers.title: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
papers.desc: Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model.

papers.title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
papers.desc: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning.

papers.title: From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents
papers.desc: Simulated environments enable scalable training data generation for embodied agents, but more data does not necessarily provide what a particular agent needs to learn.

papers.title: Choosing LLMs for Strategic Agent Interactions
papers.desc: Game-theoretic benchmarks claim that large language model (LLM) strategic decision-making varies across game types, interaction structures, and capability dimensions.

papers.title: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
papers.desc: On-policy self-distillation provides dense supervision for reasoning models via a privileged self-teacher.

papers.title: Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?
papers.desc: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires reasoning that extends beyond visible image content, demanding external commonsense and factual knowledge.

papers.title: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
papers.desc: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints.

papers.title: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
papers.desc: Scaling up transformers has produced models with broad capabilities, deployed across heterogeneous hardware and fluctuating workloads.

papers.title: Self-Conditioning Enables Deep Sequential Reasoning in Flow Matching
papers.desc: Recent work has explored visual reasoning through image generation, where models solve visual-reasoning problems by directly generating solution images.

papers.title: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
papers.desc: Professional agents increasingly work through command-line interfaces and multiple tools over shared workspaces containing files, messages, and business applications.

papers.title: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
papers.desc: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems to automate complex computer-use workflows, yet existing benchmarks mostly assume consistent, cooperative environments.

papers.title: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
papers.desc: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment.

papers.title: A Diagnostic Study of World-Space Human Recovery Under High Camera Dynamics
papers.desc: Monocular world-space human recovery methods excel on current benchmarks, but these rarely include fast camera motion.
